page.overview:
What is Attack on the Dark Fair?

In 229 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram, who was operating under the alias "Scarlet Skull" carried out an attack on the Nihil pirates Dark Fair on the Outer Rim planet Valo. Multiple explosives were set off on the landing pads, damaging Nihil ships.

The attack appeared in Escape from Valo, a 2024 junior novel written by Daniel José Older and Alyssa Wong as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's

Category:Battles of the Occupation of Valo
